entities.summary: Johan Roijakkers is a Dutch basketball coach, who is the head coach of the Kortrijk Spurs of the BNXT League. He coached eight years in the German Basketball Bundesliga with BG Göttingen and Brose Bamberg and in Italy in the Lega Basket Serie A with Pallacanestro Varese. He also competed internationally in the Basketball Champions League. Roijakkers won 3 championships in 3 different countries and was national team coach for the Netherlands U18 4 years in a row.
